criteria.requirement: Add funcy.walktree.tree_walk(root,*,children=None,follow=None,prune=None,max_depth=None), frozen WalkEvent(event,path,depth,node,pruned) and TreeCycleError(path). Default mapping keys/sequence indexes use real Funcy is_seqcont, keeping text/bytes leaves; explicit children yields labeled edges. Generate stable lazy pre/post events with an iterative stack, prune before children access and support nonnegative depth cap. Detect ancestor cycles by identity while allowing shared acyclic nodes under separate paths, propagate callbacks/source errors and leave inputs unchanged. Prove deep 1500-level trees, exact event order and balanced pruned nodes without changing old tree_nodes/leaves.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
